description: OLE-PARAM types and conversion timing on a read/write copy: one INSERT into Items with fourteen '?' markers (Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, Txt, B, Bin, Y, Sh, Bt, Sg, G) executed five times from fresh Commands with typed manual parameters (adVarWChar, adInteger, adDouble, adCurrency, adDecimal with Precision 18/Scale 4, adDate, adLongVarBinary, adVarBinary, adBoolean, adSmallInt, adUnsignedTinyInt, adSingle, adGUID): typical values; Null for all but Code; a string "abc" for the Long; a Double 3,000,000,000 for the Long; a 60-character text and a 120-byte binary. After each Execute the Connection Errors are read and cleared, then every inserted row is read with Value and ActualSize. Asks where each conversion or size failure surfaces and what is stored.
